name: paddle
label: Paddle
description: Manage customers, subscriptions, and recurring billing with Paddle Billing.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Authenticate with a Paddle API key.

Live and sandbox keys are supported automatically.

You can create API keys from **Developer Tools > Authentication** in the Paddle dashboard.

list-customers.label: List Customers
list-customers.description: Lists customers from your Paddle account.

email.label: Email
email.description: Optionally filter customers by exact email address.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return.

get-subscription.label: Get Subscription
get-subscription.description: Retrieves a Paddle subscription by ID.

subscriptionId.label: Subscription
subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

update-subscription.label: Update Subscription
update-subscription.description: Updates a Paddle subscription. Send the full recurring item list you want the subscription to keep.

subscriptionId.label: Subscription
subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

priceId.label: Recurring Price
priceId.description: Select an active recurring Paddle price.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Optional quantity for the recurring price.

prorationBillingMode.label: Proration Billing Mode
prorationBillingMode.description: How Paddle should bill for the subscription change.

customData.label: Custom Data
customData.description: Optional JSON object to store on the subscription.

cancel-subscription.label: Cancel Subscription
cancel-subscription.description: Cancels a Paddle subscription immediately or at the next billing period.

subscriptionId.label: Subscription
subscriptionId.description: Select the Paddle subscription to use.

effectiveFrom.label: Effective From
effectiveFrom.description: Choose when Paddle should apply the cancellation.

create-transaction.label: Create Transaction
create-transaction.description: Creates a Paddle transaction. When you use recurring prices, completing the transaction starts the subscription.

customerId.label: Customer
customerId.description: Select the Paddle customer to use.

addressId.label: Address
addressId.description: Select the Paddle address to bill against.

priceId.label: Recurring Price
priceId.description: Select an active recurring Paddle price.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Optional quantity for the recurring price.

customData.label: Custom Data
customData.description: Optional JSON object to store on the transaction.
